profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. Per its own site, it supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions, which it says are intended to drive innovation across the semiconductor industry. The company also states that its business model accelerates innovation in integrated circuit (IC) design and product applications, and that it contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The company is a public company traded under the ticker TSM, headquartered in Hsinchu, and it is recorded with the SEC under CIK 0001046179. No litigation, no tracked AI products, and no MCP servers are held for it.
